g.text: ✔ IMAP + SMTP: dry run by default; --send replies once, in-thread, only to the allowed and authenticated sender
✔ IMAP: a refused reply is not recorded (retried next pass); a wrong password is ok:false without the password
✔ --seed records what is due without replying; maxPerPass caps a burst
✔ plain TCP is refused to anything but a loopback host
✔ Composio Connect (ck_ key): lists mail from the allow-list, replies in the thread to the sender, labels it
✔ Composio: an error that echoes the key is redacted; a project key goes to the REST API
✔ allow-list: exact addresses and exact domains only; display names are not addresses
✔ authentication: only the topmost Authentication-Results counts
✔ decide: future, undated and threadless mail is skipped; self is never answered
✔ template and headers: mail text cannot add lines or headers
✔ IMAP reader: literals split across chunks; ledger trims oldest first; settings validate
✔ structured template: bold headline, at most three bold-lead lines, grey footer; mail text is escaped
✔ Composio never answers itself or another auto-reply, and a thread cannot ping-pong
✔ IMAP skips X-Auto-Response-Suppress, mailer-daemon, no-reply senders and a null Return-Path
✔ IMAP SINCE reaches back a day, so a server west of UTC still returns the last hour
✔ the sender is the one real addr-spec: a display name, comment or encoded word cannot stand in for it
✔ authentication must be aligned with the From domain
✔ --seed records every message it can see, past maxPerPass and whoever sent it, and sends nothing
✔ a server that goes quiet cannot hang a pass (IMAP LOGOUT, SMTP mid-dialogue)
✔ In-Reply-To is one message id; References keeps whole ids and stays inside one header line
✔ requireAuth with no Authentication-Results to read is unauthenticated, never a pass
✔ a sender is answered at most maxPerSender times a day, and a capped message is never answered later
✔ the texts say what --seed really covers on each transport
✔ a DMARC result for another domain refuses the sender whatever that result is
✔ Composio: two From headers mean no sender; the summary field never stands in for them
✔ Return-Path: only <> and mailer-daemon or postmaster are bounces; a mail service bounce address is not
ℹ tests 26
ℹ pass 26
ℹ fail 0
